tables.title_or_caption: Characteristics of COVID-19 cases in the Philippines as of 29 April 2020

study_meta.region_raw: Philippines (National Capital Region, Luzon, Visayas, Mindanao)
study_meta.period_raw: Cases recorded up to 29 April 2020; followed until 22 May 2020; exponential growth phase pre-ECQ: 11 February to 19 March 2020; ECQ period: 20 March to 9 April 2020
study_meta.population_raw: Laboratory-confirmed COVID-19 cases in the Philippines
study_meta.sample_size_raw: 8212 total cases; 55 pairs of index and secondary cases for serial interval estimation (from first 100 confirmed cases with contact tracing)
study_meta.method_raw: Clustering analysis using known epidemiologic links, exposure history and symptom onset for the first 100 confirmed COVID-19 cases where contact tracing was mandated by DOH guidelines. Distributions fitted using Akaike information criterion (AIC).
